+"""The BadEscapeError error and its helper."""
+
+import sys
+
+class BadEscapeError(Exception):
+    """Raised for bad escape problems."""
+
+
+def raise_bad_escape(message: str, line: int, column: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(message)
+    fullMessage = message if message.endswith(".") else message + "."
+    if line < 1:
+        raise BadEscapeError(fullMessage)
+    raise BadEscapeError(fullMessage)
